Project:
Salaama School
for the Blind.
Umeme
partnership with
Nature Uganda.
Focus area:
Tree planting to
restore cover (1000
trees planted).
Outcome:
• Create awareness of the environment
for Umeme staff through the U-Green
initiative.
• Create windbreakers to protect the
school against winds that destroy it.
• Educate the young on environment
conservation.
• Assure the blind that they are cared for
and part of the community.

Focus area:
Fixing a Lightning
Arrestor on the
school block.
Outcome:
• Lightning affects schools and this was to
ensure that these children are safe during
the rainy season.

Project:
Womens’ Day
visit to Refugee
camp.
Focus area:
Support the
community with food
and clothing while
imparting some skills
on financial literacy.
Outcome:
• While this is a refugee camp there are
some occupants who try to make ends
meet. A day spent with them educating
them how to save and invest was
worthwhile.
• Food items and clothing were handed to
the administrators to support the most
needy and elderly.
